$comment: Generic OBD-II codes in OpenHood's own words. 'hint' is optional practical advice for E-series cars; keep hints factual and mark guesses as 'common cause' rather than certainty.

P0010.text: Intake camshaft position actuator circuit, bank 1

P0011.text: Intake camshaft timing over-advanced or system performance, bank 1
P0011.hint: On BMW engines a common cause is a faulty VANOS solenoid or low/dirty oil.

P0012.hint: Check VANOS solenoid and oil level/condition.

P0013.text: Exhaust camshaft position actuator circuit, bank 1

P0014.text: Exhaust camshaft timing over-advanced or system performance, bank 1
P0014.hint: Check exhaust VANOS solenoid and oil condition.

P0016.text: Crankshaft/camshaft position correlation, bank 1 sensor A

P0017.text: Crankshaft/camshaft position correlation, bank 1 sensor B

P0030.text: Oxygen sensor heater control circuit, bank 1 sensor 1

P0036.text: Oxygen sensor heater control circuit, bank 1 sensor 2

P0050.text: Oxygen sensor heater control circuit, bank 2 sensor 1

P0056.text: Oxygen sensor heater control circuit, bank 2 sensor 2

P0068.text: Manifold pressure / mass air flow does not agree with throttle position
P0068.hint: Often an intake air leak after the air-mass meter.

P0087.text: Fuel rail / system pressure too low
P0087.hint: On direct-injection engines (e.g. N54) check the high-pressure and low-pressure fuel pumps.

P0088.text: Fuel rail / system pressure too high

P0101.hint: Check for intake leaks and a dirty or failing air-mass meter.

P0102.text: Mass air flow sensor circuit low

P0103.text: Mass air flow sensor circuit high

P0107.text: Manifold absolute pressure sensor circuit low

P0108.text: Manifold absolute pressure sensor circuit high

P0112.text: Intake air temperature sensor circuit low

P0113.text: Intake air temperature sensor circuit high

P0117.text: Engine coolant temperature sensor circuit low

P0118.text: Engine coolant temperature sensor circuit high

P0122.text: Throttle position sensor A circuit low

P0123.text: Throttle position sensor A circuit high

P0125.text: Coolant temperature too low for closed-loop fuel control

P0128.text: Coolant temperature below thermostat regulating temperature
P0128.hint: Very common on E46/E9x: thermostat stuck open.

P0131.text: Oxygen sensor circuit low voltage, bank 1 sensor 1

P0132.text: Oxygen sensor circuit high voltage, bank 1 sensor 1

P0133.text: Oxygen sensor slow response, bank 1 sensor 1

P0134.text: Oxygen sensor no activity, bank 1 sensor 1

P0135.text: Oxygen sensor heater circuit, bank 1 sensor 1

P0137.text: Oxygen sensor circuit low voltage, bank 1 sensor 2

P0138.text: Oxygen sensor circuit high voltage, bank 1 sensor 2

P0139.text: Oxygen sensor slow response, bank 1 sensor 2

P0140.text: Oxygen sensor no activity, bank 1 sensor 2

P0141.text: Oxygen sensor heater circuit, bank 1 sensor 2

P0151.text: Oxygen sensor circuit low voltage, bank 2 sensor 1

P0152.text: Oxygen sensor circuit high voltage, bank 2 sensor 1

P0153.text: Oxygen sensor slow response, bank 2 sensor 1

P0154.text: Oxygen sensor no activity, bank 2 sensor 1

P0155.text: Oxygen sensor heater circuit, bank 2 sensor 1

P0161.text: Oxygen sensor heater circuit, bank 2 sensor 2

P0171.hint: On M54/N52 engines common causes are a vacuum leak (crankcase vent valve, intake boot, oil filler cap seal), a dirty air-mass meter or a weak fuel pump.

P0174.hint: Lean on both banks points to a shared cause: air leak, air-mass meter or fuel delivery.

P0299.hint: On N54/N55 check for boost leaks, wastegate rattle and diverter valves.

P0300.text: Random or multiple cylinder misfire detected
P0300.hint: Check ignition coils, spark plugs, vacuum leaks and fuel delivery.

P0301.hint: Swap the coil with another cylinder: if the misfire moves, the coil is bad.

P0302.hint: Swap the coil with another cylinder: if the misfire moves, the coil is bad.

P0303.hint: Swap the coil with another cylinder: if the misfire moves, the coil is bad.

P0304.hint: Swap the coil with another cylinder: if the misfire moves, the coil is bad.

P0305.hint: Swap the coil with another cylinder: if the misfire moves, the coil is bad.

P0306.hint: Swap the coil with another cylinder: if the misfire moves, the coil is bad.

P0340.text: Camshaft position sensor A circuit, bank 1

P0341.text: Camshaft position sensor A range/performance, bank 1

P0344.text: Camshaft position sensor A circuit intermittent, bank 1

P0365.text: Camshaft position sensor B circuit, bank 1

P0411.text: Secondary air injection system incorrect flow detected
P0411.hint: Common on E46: blocked secondary air passages or a failed pump/check valve.

P0441.text: Evaporative emission system incorrect purge flow

P0442.text: Evaporative emission system small leak detected

P0455.text: Evaporative emission system large leak detected
P0455.hint: Check the fuel cap seal first.

P0456.text: Evaporative emission system very small leak detected

P0457.text: Evaporative emission leak detected (fuel cap loose/off)

P0491.text: Secondary air injection system insufficient flow, bank 1

P0492.text: Secondary air injection system insufficient flow, bank 2

P0506.text: Idle air control system RPM lower than expected

P0507.text: Idle air control system RPM higher than expected

P0562.hint: Test the battery and alternator; low voltage causes many unrelated faults on BMWs.

P0597.hint: N52/N54 electric thermostat: check the connector and thermostat.

P0604.text: Control module random access memory error

P0700.text: Transmission control system malfunction (read the transmission module for details)

P2088.text: Intake camshaft position actuator control circuit low, bank 1

P2089.text: Intake camshaft position actuator control circuit high, bank 1

P2096.text: Post-catalyst fuel trim system too lean, bank 1

P2097.text: Post-catalyst fuel trim system too rich, bank 1

P2098.text: Post-catalyst fuel trim system too lean, bank 2

P2099.text: Post-catalyst fuel trim system too rich, bank 2

P2187.text: System too lean at idle, bank 1
P2187.hint: Lean at idle but fine under load usually means a vacuum leak.

P2188.text: System too rich at idle, bank 1

P2189.text: System too lean at idle, bank 2

P2190.text: System too rich at idle, bank 2
